lastProgressReport.summary: Run 37862641069 proved SSOT, workbook, core-concept and volume gates green. It then exposed a brittle surface-QA assertion that demanded exactly h10 workspaces even though the overflow-safe page 41 correctly uses h8. The gate now verifies the presence/count of dedicated work areas independently of their safe height. Progress stays 60/40 until the full browser/mobile/print/PDF run completes green.
